en.description:
Your next arcade break is right on your wrist.

RETRO NEON GAMES brings nine retro games to Apple Watch, from quick reflex challenges to fishing, memory puzzles and classic board-game strategy. Pick a game, turn the Digital Crown or tap the screen, and make a few spare minutes more fun.

EXPLORE THE COLLECTION

• Ping Pond — Move your paddle, return the ball and keep the rally going in a colorful arcade showdown.
• Ocean Fishing — Move your boat, time your cast and reel in fish with the Digital Crown before time runs out.
• Momories — Remember the pixel-art cards and match every pair.
• Paw Trail — Run and jump through a platform adventure, timing your moves to clear obstacles.
• Neon Lander — Guide your spacecraft to a safe landing. Balance thrust, rotation and fuel to reach the landing pad.
• Pulse Mosaic — Rotate and place falling blocks, complete lines and keep the board from filling up.
• Neon Snake — Collect food, grow your snake and avoid running into your own tail.
• Checkers — Plan your moves, capture pieces and crown your kings. Play against the computer or share the watch for a local two-player game.
• Comet Drift — Pilot your craft through an arcade shooting mission, dodge incoming threats and take on enemies.

MADE FOR APPLE WATCH

Enjoy retro pixel art, neon colors, sound and haptic feedback, with touch and Digital Crown controls tailored to each game. Choose from three difficulty levels, chase local high scores and return to your saved progress. Polish and English language options are included, and no account is required.

START FREE, UNLOCK MORE

Ping Pond and Ocean Fishing are free to play. Unlock the other seven games permanently with one full-version in-app purchase. No subscription. If you have already purchased the full version, use Restore Purchase in the app.

Nine games. One wrist. Pick your next challenge.
en.releaseNotes:
More ways to play, right on your wrist.

• Play Ping Pond and Ocean Fishing for free.
• Unlock the other seven games permanently with one full-version purchase, with Restore Purchase support.
• Enjoy improvements to Momories, Neon Snake controls and Checkers.
• Refined the difficulty of Paw Trail and Neon Lander.
• Improved the pause screen and app-wide sound controls.
• Completed English and Polish translations.
• Removed Maze and Neon Circuits from the collection.
en.subtitle: Classic Games on Your Wrist

zh.description:
RETRO NEON GAMES is a collection of short arcade games made for your wrist.

Choose a game, turn the Digital Crown and jump straight into the action. Each session takes only a moment, while new stages, rising difficulty and high scores keep you coming back for one more try.

The collection includes 11 different games:
• Ping Pond
• Ocean Fishing
• Momories
• Trail Runner
• Neon Lander
• Neon Tetris
• Neon Snake
• Checkers
• Comet Drift
• Maze
• Neon Circuits

KEY FEATURES
• controls designed for your watch and Digital Crown
• short sessions that fit into a few spare minutes
• varied stages with progressive unlocking
• three difficulty levels
• local high scores and saved progress
• retro neon pixel art
• sound and haptic feedback
• no account required

Put on your watch and discover how much arcade fun can fit on your wrist.
zh.releaseNotes: Improved element visibility and controls, plus bug fixes for a smoother experience.
